#: CodeRabbit configuration - controlled by repository. Do NOT store secrets here.
notes: To integrate with CI or to provide an API token for an external delegated agent, set the token via repository secrets and reference it from your automation. Keep auto_review_on_pr_open=false to avoid spamming preview deploys; use the 'coderabbit-review' label to explicitly request a delegated review. Set 'allow_bot_prs' to true to allow reviews on PRs authored by bots.
